direct_metadata_probe.method: anonymous GET to Zenodo public record API
direct_metadata_probe.record_terms: By downloading, users agree to non-commercial research use in specified fields, no user re-identification, citation, and responsibility for third-party rights.

officially_described_task_data.grouping: User-screen/session groups; the same screen composition and ordering is shared across users
officially_described_task_data.version_note: v2 corrects impression omissions in fewer than five percent of cases; official record recommends v2

architecture_and_task_assessment.dense_mlp_compatibility: Structurally compatible after fixed-width encoding of numeric positions and categorical user/movie/genre/session fields; retain session/screen IDs as grouping metadata rather than ordinal features.
architecture_and_task_assessment.candidate_task: Pointwise click-response classification among exposed/impressed carousel items.
architecture_and_task_assessment.split_requirement: Group by user and screen/session; never random-split rows because users share identical screens and each session yields many correlated item rows.
architecture_and_task_assessment.full_batch_estimate: Expected to fit due to small released files, but exact parsed row count, transformed one-hot width, and measured peak GPU memory were not established.

difficulty_assessment.reason: The release fails the explicit no-dataset-specific-agreement and open-license criteria before model training; only 87 users and 30 repeated screens also make independent-group difficulty uncertain.

disposition: CROSS OUT. Public/free record metadata and listed files are not sufficient: the dataset is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and its download terms impose non-commercial research conditions and other obligations. No payload GET, parse, or MLP pilot is claimed. The separate non-public full dataset is request-controlled and is also excluded.
